inspected_contracts.finding: Native delivery constructs UnitAttack(target), sets IsCharge, IgnoreCooldown, Init(caster), AddToQueueFirst; does not set ForceFullAttack or IsSingleAttack.
Default single/full flags remain false; Init invokes InitAttacks. OnlyForInspect guards animation setup.

Charge + Pounce + TB surprise selects full before ordinary restrictions; otherwise a non-single charge needs Pounce, no Staggered and IsFullAttackRestricted(false). The latter receives native CombatState.IsFullAttackRestrictedBecauseOfMoveAction.
In TB combat, restricted movement refuses full before IgnoreCooldown bypasses spent action restriction; RT retains supplied recent-move restriction.
TB uses UsedOneMoveAction / current full-attack selection; RT compares LastUsageOfMoveActionTime + 3 seconds with native GameTime.
Ordinary availability requires neither UsedStandardAction nor UsedOneMoveAction. This is an ability affordability check, not the queued attack rule.

verification: Native assembly IL plus compiled-route/scalar audit and unit tests. No actor, flight, queue, animation or attack executed offline. RT forecast keeps current recent-move restriction and gives no speculative credit for its expiry during flight.
